metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented the Rust Cargo project under [Cargo.toml](/workspace/output/Cargo.toml) and [main.rs](/workspace/output/src/main.rs). The binary accepts the requested CLI flags, writes the final machine-state JSON, supports optional tool/parameter files, block delete, probing configuration, and emits delta trace JSON with time, distance, or tolerance-based sampling.

Verification: `cargo build --release --manifest-path /workspace/output/Cargo.toml` succeeds. I also spot-checked linear motion, canned-cycle trace output, G92 state changes, and an error path to confirm both `--output` and `--trace-output` are written on failure.
